plan.site_query: مجلس التعاون الخليج الذكاء الاصطناعي استراتيجية

moments.quote: The United Arab Emirates is a country that prides itself on building big and being first and that extends to the tech sector with the UAE's appointment of the world's first minister for artificial intelligence. Behind the ministry's creation is the Emirates' lofty ambition to be the global leader in AI and for that commitment to boost the UAE's GDP by 35% by 2031.
moments.why: La journaliste présente la stratégie et les ambitions des Émirats arabes unis dans le domaine de l'intelligence artificielle.

moments.quote: So some of our most successful exits so far are artificial intelligence stories of success. Careem is an artificial intelligence company that got acquired for 11 billion dirhams, 3.1 or 3.2 billion dollars. Souq.com got acquired by Amazon for more than 2 billion dirhams, and Media.net got acquired for more than 3 billion dirhams. These are all artificial intelligence companies in their core, and these are probably their proof that our leadership has been working on this for years.
moments.speaker_name: H.E. Omar Bin Sultan Al Olama
moments.why: Le ministre émirati de l'IA détaille les réussites et investissements dans l'intelligence artificielle aux EAU.

moments.quote: Definitely, and it also proves that there is something to be got out of it. We're not doing AI for the sake of AI, we're doing AI because it's something that creates value, and there are returns that make it tangible and feasible as well to do.
moments.speaker_name: H.E. Omar Bin Sultan Al Olama
moments.why: Le ministre émirati explique la valeur économique et stratégique des investissements en IA pour le pays.

videos.title: نشرة الرابعة |  ولي العهد السعودي يرعى القمة العالمية للذكاء الاصطناعي

moments.quote: تحتضن الرياض غدا وبعد غد أول قمة عالمية للذكاء الاصطناعي برعاية ولي العهد السعودي الأمير محمد بن سلمان تحت شعار الذكاء الاصطناعي لخير البشرية والتي تشرف عليها هيئة البيانات والذكاء الاصطناعي السعودية سدايا
moments.why: La présentatrice annonce officiellement la tenue à Riyad du Sommet mondial de l'IA organisé sous le patronage du prince héritier saoudien et de SDAIA.

moments.quote: وهذا هو دورنا في سدايا وهذا هو دورنا في القمة لتبيين الحقائق لرسم المستقبل الجديد للذكاء الاصطناعي الذي سيكون بإذن الله خيرا للبشرية
moments.why: Le porte-parole officiel de SDAIA expose le rôle et la vision de l'Arabie saoudite concernant l'avenir et la gouvernance de l'intelligence artificielle.

videos.title: نشرة الرابعة: الغامدي: السعودية تسعى إلى أن تكون ملتقى للعالم في احتضان الذكاء الاصطناعي

moments.quote: فعاليات القمة العالمية للذكاء الاصطناعي الأولى عالميا انطلقت بمشاركة مئات الخبراء والمسؤولين والمستثمرين في المجال التقني من حول العالم وبإشراف الهيئة السعودية للبيانات والذكاء الاصطناعي سدايا
moments.why: Le journaliste présente le lancement du Sommet mondial de l'IA organisé en Arabie saoudite sous la supervision de la SDAIA.

moments.quote: وفي افتتاح القمة، قال رئيس الهيئة السعودية للبيانات والذكاء الاصطناعي عبد الله الغامدي، قال إن السعودية تسعى لأن تكون ملتقى رئيسيا للعالم للشرق والغرب لاحتضان الذكاء الاصطناعي وتسخير قدراته لخدمة الإنسانية جمعاء.
moments.why: Le journaliste rapporte les propos officiels du président de la SDAIA sur les ambitions saoudiennes en matière d'intelligence artificielle.

moments.quote: نسعى لأن نصبح ملتقى رئيسا للعالم للشرق والغرب نحتضن الذكاء الاصطناعي ونسخر قدراته معا ونطلق إمكاناته لخير الإنسانية جمعاء.
moments.why: Le président de la SDAIA détaille la vision et la stratégie de l'Arabie saoudite pour accueillir et développer l'IA.

videos.title: UAE AI Minister: Country is against “regulating tech for the sake of regulating” | CNBC Conversation

moments.quote: So we are playing a big role in trying to start the discussions on where we should regulate artificial intelligence. I'm not for overregulation and the UAE is not for regulating a technology for the sake of regulating it. But we are for proactive regulations of certain uses of the technology.
moments.why: Le ministre de l'IA des Émirats arabes unis expose la vision et la stratégie de son pays concernant la régulation proactive de l'intelligence artificielle.

moments.quote: So AI should not be used to automate weapons that will kill people on a mass scale. Is there a dialogue that's being had? Maybe. But the UAE is playing a big role in trying to really start these discussions and see where they can lead.
moments.why: Omar Al Olama détaille la position des Émirats sur l'interdiction de l'IA pour les armes autonomes et l'initiative du pays pour initier ce dialogue international.

videos.title: Aramco CEO Amin Nasser on the Future of Oil, AI & Saudi Vision 2030 (Extended Interview)

moments.quote: There is significant growth, as I'm sure you've seen through the tours, in technology and digitalization, in AI, to maintain our low-cost structure, extraction cost and development cost, and at the same time reduce our carbon footprint.
moments.why: Le PDG de Saudi Aramco détaille l'adoption de l'IA et des technologies pour optimiser les opérations et réduire l'empreinte carbone.

moments.quote: Technology realization in 2023 used to be $2 billion. This is how much we realized from technology. In '24, $4 billion. And we're looking at $2 to $4 billion per year in technology. So we are benefiting out from these technology application. AI is in everything embedded, not only in terms of allowing us to reduce our cost structure, more efficiency, it also helps us in reducing our carbon footprint.
moments.why: Le patron d'Aramco chiffre les gains financiers apportés par la technologie et l'IA dans les activités de la compagnie.

moments.quote: If you look at our talents, how many people trained on AI in Aramco? We have the AI specialist, a couple of hundreds, but the AI-enabled, trained AI professional around more than 6,000, and we're training more and more every year.
moments.why: Le dirigeant détaille les investissements humains et la formation de milliers d'employés d'Aramco aux outils d'IA.

videos.title: Inside the Gulf’s trillion-dollar AI gamble

moments.quote: With energy and cash to spare, Gulf monarchies are positioning their countries and their capital to take a lead in the AI race, both acquiring and building the latest technology. I took a deep dive into the sovereign strategies of Abu Dhabi, Riyadh, and Doha and looked at how each major player is investing across artificial intelligence to gain a foothold in this space.
moments.why: La journaliste CNBC détaille les stratégies et investissements massifs des pays du Golfe (Abu Dhabi, Riyad, Doha) dans la course à l'intelligence artificielle.

moments.quote: From Abu Dhabi's G42 and MGX, and their massive US-UAE AI campus, to the lifting of export controls for Nvidia chips announced this week by Microsoft. The UAE was talking about AI before it was cool, according to Sam Altman.
moments.why: La journaliste présente les initiatives majeures de l'IA aux Émirats arabes unis (G42, MGX, campus IA USA-EAU).

moments.quote: And Riyadh has its own AI champion, Humain, backed by its nearly $1 trillion Sovereign Wealth Fund, the PIF. They want to make Saudi Arabia the biggest AI power after the likes, of course, of the US and China.
moments.why: Présentation des investissements et de l'ambition de l'Arabie saoudite et du PIF pour faire du pays une puissance mondiale de l'intelligence artificielle.

moments.quote: Plus Qatar, who's over $500 billion Sovereign Wealth Fund, the QIA, told CNBC their strategy is investing across the value stack of AI, rather than backing a single local AI company like the UAE's G42 or Saudi's Humain.
moments.why: La journaliste rapporte la stratégie d'investissement du Qatar (QIA) dans la chaîne de valeur de l'intelligence artificielle.

videos.title: Saudi Arabia Plans $100 Billion AI Project to Rival UAE Technology Hub

moments.quote: So sources are telling us that Saudi Arabia is planning a project known as Project Transcendence. We are told that this is going to be a fund that will invest in AI infrastructure, AI startups, and also companies that are willing to commit their resources to the kingdom in order to help the country scale up in its AI ambitions.
moments.why: La journaliste rapporte les plans de l'Arabie saoudite concernant le projet 'Project Transcendence' doté de milliards pour l'infrastructure et les startups IA.

moments.quote: Well, both Saudi Arabia and the UAE have been racing to set up data centers and kind of position themselves as the dominant force in AI in the region. And honestly, so far it had looked like Abu Dhabi was pulling ahead. Abu Dhabi has its G42 fund, which is a massive fund that has secured huge commitments from Microsoft and also we saw a deal struck back in September with Nvidia.
moments.why: La journaliste décrit la compétition entre l'Arabie saoudite et les Émirats arabes unis (Abu Dhabi, G42) dans les investissements et infrastructures d'intelligence artificielle.

moments.quote: And then last week out of FII, we also saw the PIF, that's Saudi Arabia's sovereign wealth fund, it announced a partnership with Google Cloud to develop a new AI hub in the Eastern Province of Dammam. Sources told us that that initiative or that new AI hub could see investments of as much as 10 billion dollars.
moments.why: Détails du partenariat officiel entre le PIF saoudien et Google Cloud pour un hub IA à Dammam avec 10 milliards de dollars d'investissements.
